title: Annotation API text embedder response
description: Response body of POST /api/text-embedder/. The server sends every key listed here, with null when there is no value.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

sys_id.description: Identifier of the system (model) that served the request.

seconds.description: Processing time of the request, in seconds.
